cli.help.overview: fresnel: interactive agent runtime Usage: fresnel [common flags] [command] [arguments] Commands chat Interactive mode (default). Switches to print mode when the terminal is not interactive chat -p Print mode: run one turn with this input and write the reply to stdout -p - or a bare -p reads all of stdin as the input chat -p --json JSON mode: write the JSON-RPC messages exchanged with the engine, one per line chat -p --auto-approve Print mode: approve a tool call once. Questions, plans, and reviews are declined chat --continue Resume the last session in the current working folder chat --resume Resume the given session chat --set = Override a setting for this session only (can be repeated) sessions ls [--all] [--limit n] [--json] sessions show [--json] sessions fork [--at ] sessions rm [--yes] List, show, fork, and delete sessions sessions rename Change the session title (200 characters or fewer) config get [<key>…] Show the effective values and where they come from config schema --scope <managed|user|project|local> [--out <path>] [--core-only] Write the JSON Schema for the settings files config set <key> <value> [--scope user|project|local] config reset <key> [--scope user|project|local] config list [--prefix <p>] [--deprecated] [--json] Set, clear, and list settings secret ls|add|set|meta|rotate|rm|test|reveal Manage secrets. Values are read only from a prompt or stdin. Use reveal only in a terminal trust [status] [--json] Show the project trust state for this working folder, and the choices trust allow|deny [--scope folder|parent|session] Send a trust decision. When trusted, .mcp.json, project skills, and project commands are read db export <folder> [--json] [--yes] Export the storage files read-only, without the engine. The engine may be running db restore <folder> [--json] Restore a database from an export. Close the engine first. Secrets need the age key separately schedule add <prompt…> (--every <seconds> | --at <time> | --remote | --watch <path>[,…] | --loop <seconds> …) Create a schedule. If service mode is off, it is only saved and does not run. See fresnel help schedule schedule list [--all] [--json] schedule cancel <id> Turn a schedule off schedule run <id> Run a remote schedule once, now service start|status|stop|ensure [--json] [--safe-mode] [--listen-tcp <host>:<port> [--allow-non-loopback]] Shared service mode. start and ensure start the service, or attach to it if it is running. status and stop check it and stop it. Safe mode and TCP apply only when a new service starts Schedules run only in service mode. See fresnel help schedule group new <name> [--drive|--policy] [--dir <folder>] [--json] Create a group skeleton. The default is an observe group, --drive makes a drive group, and --policy makes a policy group. The target folder must be empty, and dependencies are not installed doctor [--json] Diagnose the engine, storage, secret store, terminal, and search providers version [--json] Show the version Common flags -h, --help Show help --no-color Turn off color (the NO_COLOR environment variable does the same) -C <folder> Working folder --remote <address> Remote service address. Takes precedence over the l0.process.service.remote setting unix:/abs, tcp://host:port, ssh://[user@]host[:port]/abs/socket Exit codes 0 ok 1 error 2 usage error 3 environment problem 4 session locked 129 SIGHUP 130 interrupted (Ctrl+C) 143 SIGTERM
cli.help.topic.chat:
Usage: fresnel chat [-p [<input>]] [--json] [--auto-approve] [--continue | --resume <id>] [--set <key>=<value>]…

  -p, --print [<input>]  Print mode. If the input is missing or is -, all of stdin is the input
  --json                 In print mode, write the JSON-RPC messages, one per line
  --auto-approve         In print mode, approve a tool call once. Each approval is reported on stderr.
                         Questions, plans, and review approvals are declined. Using it in interactive mode is a usage error
  --continue             Resume the last session in the current working folder
  --resume <id>          Resume the given session
  --set <key>=<value>    Override a setting for this session only (can be repeated)

cli.help.topic.db:
Usage: fresnel db export <folder> [--json] [--yes]
       fresnel db restore <folder> [--json]

  <folder>      Folder to export to. It is created if it is missing. If it exists, it must be empty. A relative path is based on the working folder (-C)
  --json        Write the export result (destDir, exportedAt, blobCount, missingBlobs) as JSON
  --yes         Skip the confirmation. The copy may contain secret values in plain text. Without a terminal this flag is required

  Creates <folder>/fresnel.sqlite, <folder>/blobs/, and <folder>/manifest.json. The engine is not started.

  restore puts an export back in place of the current database. It verifies the backup first, refuses while an engine is running, refuses a backup from a newer version, and keeps the current database in <data directory>/restore-previous/. Run it again if it was interrupted.
  Secrets are not in the backup: the age key (secrets/age/keys.txt) and the config file are not copied. Keep the age key separately.
cli.help.topic.schedule:
Usage: fresnel schedule add <prompt…> (--every <seconds> | --at <time> | --remote | --watch <path>[,<path>…] | --loop <seconds> --max-iterations <n> --expires-in <seconds>)
                       [--title <title>] [--workspace <folder>] [--disabled]
       fresnel schedule list [--all] [--json]
       fresnel schedule cancel <id>
       fresnel schedule run <id>

  --every <seconds>      Run the prompt in a new session every this many seconds. The minimum is 300 seconds
  --at <time>            Run once at an RFC 3339 time
  --remote               Does not run on a schedule. Run it now with fresnel schedule run <id>
  --watch <path>[,…]     Run when a path changes. Waits for --debounce <ms> (default 1000) before running
  --loop <seconds>       Repeat the same prompt. Give --max-iterations and --expires-in with it
  --title <title>        Title shown in the list (200 characters or fewer)
  --workspace <folder>   Working folder of the run session. If it is omitted, the default folder of the host is used
  --disabled             Create it, but leave it turned off
  --remote is a trigger flag. Give the remote service address before the command (fresnel --remote <address> schedule list)
  Schedules run only in service mode. If it is off, they are only saved, and one warning line is shown
